svg.aria-label: Crosshand workflow metro map: a sender composes and SHA-pins an H-*.md exchange file, commits it and opens an announce PR; the merged mail flows to the receiver who verifies freshness, passes the human promote gate and replies, with human discussion riding the PR thread via @handle and an optional to:room broadcast
svg.title: Crosshand workflow overview
